findings.title: Environment variable read not in Settings class
findings.explanation: os.environ.get("PAYMENTS_REDIS_URL") violates team convention requiring all environment variables to be defined in Settings class. This ensures visibility in config docs, prevents test crashes from missing variables at import time, and maintains PAYMENTS_ prefix convention.
findings.recommendation: Add REDIS_URL to app/config.py Settings class and use Settings().redis_url here. Import settings from app.config at module level.
